blocks.text: drank. Rasulullaah ﷺ then prayed, "May the righteous always eat your food, may fasting people end their fasts with you and may the angels always pray for your forgiveness. O Allaah! Shower Your choicest mercies on the family of Sa'd bin Ubaadah."[^1] Another narration also from Hadhrat Anas (RA) states that Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) served some sesame seeds and dates to Rasulullaah ﷺ.[^2]

Hadhrat Urwa (RA) reports that he once saw Hadhrat Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA) announce from his house, "Whoever wishes to eat fat or meat should go to Sa'd bin Ubaadah!" I then also saw his son doing the same (after his father's death). He narrates further that (after the death of the son) he was once walking in the streets of Madinah when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) passed by him and as he was proceeding to his property in the upper part of Madinah. Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "Dear youngster! Go an see whether there is anyone announcing from the house of Sa'd bin Ubaadah." When Hadhrat Urwa (RA) saw that there was no one announcing and reported back, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "You are right (none could be as generous as that father and son)."[^3]
Hadhrat Abu Shu'ayb Ansaari (RA) Feeds people
The Incident of him with Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Abu Mas'ood Ansaari (RA) reports that there was a Sahabi from amongst the Ansaar who was called Abu Shu'ayb (RA). He had a slave who was an expert in cooking meat. He once instructed his slave to prepare a meal so that he could invite Rasulullaah ﷺ and four other people. He then invited Rasulullaah ﷺ and four others. However, another person came along with them. (When they arrived at the house) Rasulullaah ﷺ said to Hadhrat Abu Shu'ayb (RA), "You have invited five of us but this person has come along with us. You may permit him to join or leave him out." Hadhrat Abu Shu'ayb (RA) said, "He is most welcome."[^4]

Another narration states that when Hadhrat Abu Shu'ayb (RA) once saw Rasulullaah ﷺ, he noticed the sign of hunger on Rasulullaah ﷺ's face. He then said to his slave, "How terrible! Cook some food for five people."[^5]
